title: Level 3 (Advanced) - D-13
notes:
West leads the ♠K against 6♥. South wins the ♠A and, with no possible losers outside of the trump suit, South should focus his attention on playing the hearts for 1 loser. The contract will be easy unless one of the defenders was dealt 4 hearts.

There is only one way to guarantee the contract against all possible 4-1 breaks. South should play a heart to dummy's ♥K at trick 2 and then cross back to his hand in order to lead a low heart toward dummy's ♥J. If West started with 4 hearts to the ♥Q10 he can do no better than to take his ♥Q and force the dummy with a second round of spades. South can unblock the ♥J, and cross back to his hand to draw the last trump.

If West discards on the second round of trump, dummy's ♥J will force East's ♥Q. South can win any return and draw the rest of the trump by finessing against East's ♥10. The contract is at risk against some 4-1 heart breaks if South plays the trump suit in any other manner.
